scope: contemporary raw deterministic CPU reference; diagnostics serialize callbacks and are not throughput

power.scope: open lid and constant known power at sampled times; wall/perf drift<=2s, not proof of every hardware power event

command: La capitale de la France est
guard.sampling_scope: sum of owned process and descendant RSS; shared pages may be counted twice
guard.swap_scope: system wide; other applications can cause a conservative stop

analysis.denominator: N-1 completed autoregressive decode calls for N emitted IDs; prefill/first output excluded

serialized_operations.scope: serialized operation callback diagnostics; not production throughput
interpretation: operation wall time includes arithmetic, memory access, page-fault wait and backend scheduling
CPU seconds are summed across threads; CPU/wall ratio may exceed one and is not an IO percentage
residency is inspected before the operation timer/counter snapshots, without dereferencing weights
selected logical bytes and repeated residency snapshots are not physical disk traffic or unique pages
nonresident pages may be satisfied from macOS file cache; they are not proven NAND reads
per-process OS storage read deltas and pageins remain separate counters
step0 is the initial prompt prefill in this helper; later steps decode one forced/generated token
